legal_form.pdf.notes: Synthetic legal/corporate-filing-style PDF (Companies Act / Articles of Association wording), mirroring the real INC-34 case found during the C2 Sandbox Product Validation (see Tests/C2 Sandbox Product Validation Report.md, Finding 1). Correct answer is Document — a live judgment pass should not leave this Unknown.

b3f0a1c2-91e4-4a2b-9c7a-2f6e9d1a7c88.jpg.notes: Synthetic UI-like image (payment-amount card layout) with a UUID-style filename and dimensions (600x1284) deliberately outside core/images.py's _COMMON_SCREEN_RESOLUTIONS, mirroring the real screenshot found in the C2 validation (Finding 2, PT-002's disclosed trade-off). Correct answer is Screenshot even though the deterministic filename/resolution split alone won't reach it without a judgment pass or a future correction.

photo.jpg.notes: Synthetic gradient/shape composition — a genuine non-screenshot image. Correct answer is Image.

ambiguous_note.txt.notes: Three short, contextless lines with no identifying content. Genuinely ambiguous even to a human reader. Correct answer IS Unknown — a provider that also lands here is being appropriately cautious, not wrong; see run_harness.py's accuracy definition.

archive.zip.notes: Deterministic (extension-based, Module 02 Pass 1) — never reaches a provider call. Included so the harness's tier-distribution/naming-quality metrics reflect a realistic mix, not only provider-dependent cases.

MyApp_1.2.3_Mac.dmg.notes: Deterministic (extension-based). Included for the same reason as archive.zip.
